LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_RavenLiquidHemostasis.label: (Raven) Liquid Hemostasis
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_RavenLiquidHemostasis.descr: Viscous raven liquid temporarily seals open wounds and suppresses blood loss. It neither tends nor repairs the injuries, so proper medical treatment is still required.
